entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling because I'd like to return my VeloBand Pulse.
Certainly, I can look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Chen, and the order number is... VF77819-A.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, which was delivered about fifteen days ago. To make sure I'm pointing you in the right direction, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it works fine. I guess I just... changed my mind. I really thought I would use it every day, but I just don't use it. It was a bit of an impulse buy.
I understand. It's a powerful device, and sometimes it can feel like a lot to get started. Just to confirm, there's no defect with the band itself?
No, it's not broken. I just don't want it anymore. I'm just so confused by all the settings. Can I get the information to send it back?

I appreciate the clarification, Sarah. Looking at the policy for this specific item, the VeloBand Pulse has a 10-day return window from the date of delivery. This is because once the device is activated, it's linked to a user account, and for hygiene reasons, we can't accept them back after that period. Since your order was delivered 15 days ago, we're unfortunately outside the timeframe for a refund.
Ten days? I thought VeloFit had a 90-day policy. I'm so overwhelmed, I didn't see that on the website at all. It's basically brand new. Can't you just help me?
I absolutely want to help you find a good solution. While a direct return isn't an option, we do have a very popular alternative. We run an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace for our customers.
A resale marketplace? What's that?

It's a community platform we host where you can sell your VeloFit gear directly to other enthusiasts who are looking for it. The Pulse is in high demand, and our customers often recoup most of their original purchase price very quickly. It's a fantastic way to ensure the device goes to a good home and isn't just sitting in a box.
Oh. So... other people would buy it? Is it hard to do?

Not at all, it's very straightforward. We provide the secure platform for the listing and connection. I can send you a direct link to the Marketplace with a simple guide on how to create your post. Would you like me to do that?
Yes, I guess that's better than nothing. It sounds like a good option, actually. Please send me the link.
Of course. I've just sent that email to the address on your account. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sarah?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
